test.description: ACL: project-level role assignment (Manager/Viewer on specific projects) and permission verification without external auth system. The audit log records the refused and the accepted sign-ins, the projects created and the roles granted and changed, finds the events of one project and exports them (EPBDS-14601). The Username field of the Add access dialog on the Management tab of a project hints at a username, not at an email address (EPBDS-16598). When the admin removes the project role of a user who has the project open, the project disappears from the user's list (EPBDS-14474)
